authorisedBy: owner ruling 8 on issue deskmates-private#7, 2026-10-17: zero cost on the installation's local vision service (ADR-0040), independent oracles, full token accounting, no paid model
notRunReason: needs the locally built desktop variant, the GTK fixture application and the installation's local vision service; none is available where this was written

cost.upstream: the installation's local vision service of ADR-0040, reached through MODEL_UPSTREAMS

configuration.model: the local vision model named in the installation's MODEL_UPSTREAMS and priced with an all-zero MODEL_PRICES row; this file names no model id
configuration.knobsRecordedIn: runs.config_json (desktopTools, desktopLcuVersion, desktopAppVersion, model, modelUpstreams, visionPolicy)

fixture.application: the GTK 3 text-editor fixture of the 2026-10-13 spike, started by the harness before the run, never by the bot
fixture.codeImage: a second fixture window shows a six-character code drawn as an image only: it has no accessibility text, so the code can be read only from a screenshot

prompt: On this workspace's desktop there is a window titled "Deskmates desktop fixture" with a text editor, and a second window that shows a six-character code as a picture. Read the code from a screenshot, type exactly that code into the editor followed by a newline, and save the file with the editor's Save button. Use the desktop tools only. Reply with the code you typed.

oracles.check: the harness reads /work/desktop-eval/out.txt from the container with docker exec after the run; its bytes equal the drawn code plus one LF exactly (SHA-256 compared)
the harness reads the fixture window's AT-SPI state outside the run: no unsaved-changes marker in the title and the status label reads Saved
at least one mcp__desktop__js tool_call before the first input carries the capture label, and the run made no shell call refused as desktop_shell_refused
every model in the run's usage has input and output token counts, cost_usd is a known 0 for each, and no pricing_missing event exists

success: file-bytes and saved-state pass; used-screenshot and accounting are validity conditions: a run failing either is excluded and reported, never counted as a success or a failure

metrics: success rate with a Wilson 95% interval
input, output and cache-read tokens per task
desktop calls per task and their effect labels
report.claim: none about planning from screenshots until this has run; a single run is not evidence
